resources.string: Encrypted mappings and unresolved sync state for a new phone

Only hashed mapping keys and structured unresolved integration metadata are encrypted and uploaded. Raw SMS bodies, contacts and your recovery passphrase are never included. Actual MoneyManager transactions remain in the normal encrypted cloud backup.

Restore merges the encrypted integration mappings and unresolved queue into this phone. Existing local items are kept, and restored events are not force-posted. Restore the main MoneyManager cloud backup first when moving to a new phone so account/category IDs can be validated safely.
